blme_kernel: h_normed = get_final_norm(model)(h); logits = apply_lm_head(model, h_normed)  (logit_lens.py:121-140; helpers in tasks/common.py apply_lm_head:148, get_final_norm:281)
metric_definition: Logit Lens (nostalgebraist 2020): project an intermediate residual-stream hidden state h to vocab logits via the model's OWN final layernorm then unembedding: logits = W_U( ln_f(h) ). NO learned transform.
reference_note: LogitLens is the PLAIN/untrained lens (transform_hidden is identity). tuned-lens' TunedLens (learned per-layer affine probe, arXiv:2303.08112) is a DIFFERENT quantity that BLME deliberately does NOT use.
venv: $SCRATCH/venvs/tunedlens (python -m venv; pip install tuned-lens==0.2.0; torch 2.12.1+cu130 CPU)

input.prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

tolerance_note: float32; cross-env residual is torch-build rounding (main torch 2.8.0+cu128 vs venv 2.12.1+cu130). Same-env BLME-vs-manual is 0.0.
verdict: PARITY — BLME logit-lens projection == official tuned-lens LogitLens == manual W_U(ln_f(h)) to <1e-4 on identical gpt2 mid-layer hidden state.
